<section class="home-task" data-for="guitar piano bass drums voice">
  <h2>Learn a song from a recording</h2>

    <li><a href="tools/timestamp-notes.html">Timestamp Notes</a> — load a YouTube link or file, stamp the sections, tap the bars, loop phrase by phrase.</li>
    <li><a href="tools/tap-along.html">Tap Along</a> — the same mapping on a phone, while the song plays in another app.</li>
    <li><a href="lessons/timestamp-player.html">Mapping a Recording</a> — the lesson that walks you through it.</li>
    <li class="more">Also: <a href="lessons/section-labels.html">Naming sections</a>, <a href="tools/chunk-practice.html">Chunk Practice</a> for the fast bits</li>
  </ul>
</section>

<section class="home-task" data-for="guitar piano bass drums voice">
  <h2>Play along with a band</h2>
  <ul>

    <li><a href="styles/index.html">Styles</a> — swing to reggaeton: hear what each groove does before you choose.</li>
    <li><a href="lessons/first-rock-song.html">Your first rock song</a> — a guided first session with the band.</li>
    <li class="more">Also: <a href="tools/drumset.html">Drum Set</a>, <a href="tools/accomp-styles.html">Accompaniment styles</a></li>
  </ul>

    <li><a href="lessons/write-an-ending.html">Write an Ending</a> — finish an unfinished song's last two bars.</li>
    <li><a href="practice/dictation.html">Dictation</a> — hear a line, write it, get it marked note by note.</li>
    <li class="more">Also: <a href="lessons/notation-choices.html">Notation choices</a>, <a href="tools/notation-rules.html">Notation rules</a></li>

    <li><a href="lessons/guitar-tuning-ear.html">Tuning by ear</a> — why the ear comes first.</li>
    <li class="more">Also: <a href="lessons/strobe-tuner.html">Strobe tuner</a>, <a href="lessons/guitar-harmonics.html">Harmonics</a></li>

<script>
(function () {
  var bar = document.querySelector('.home-filter'); if (!bar) return;
  var tasks = document.querySelectorAll('.home-task');
  function show(f) {
    bar.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.f === f)); });
    tasks.forEach(function (t) { t.hidden = f !== 'all' && (' ' + t.dataset.for + ' ').indexOf(' ' + f + ' ') < 0; });
    try { localStorage.setItem('home-for', f); } catch (e) {}
  }
  bar.addEventListener('click', function (e) { var b = e.target.closest('button'); if (b) show(b.dataset.f); });
  var saved = null; try { saved = localStorage.getItem('home-for'); } catch (e) {}
  if (saved && bar.querySelector('[data-f="' + saved + '"]')) show(saved);
})();
</script>
